new_processes.name: Annuity deal revision
new_processes.definition: Asking settlements to revise or enter internal annuity deals between books to compensate for unsold energy.

new_processes.name: Job posting drafting
new_processes.definition: Drafting and editing job postings for open trading desk positions.

new_processes.name: Trading position approval
new_processes.definition: Seeking and recording management approval and limits for proposed month-long trading positions and book limits.

new_processes.name: El Paso lending schedule handling
new_processes.definition: Booking, scheduling and correcting deals for lending arrangements with El Paso Electric, and instructing traders how to handle them.

new_processes.name: Desk staffing role change
new_processes.definition: Reassigning duties of desk staff, such as moving a person toward trading support.

new_processes.name: Contingency seat planning
new_processes.definition: Collecting desk counts needed at a backup floor in case the new building becomes unusable.
